text: I feel an intellectual spark moving through this space. The informal gathering in the first image fills me with anticipation, as though everyone is waiting for something meaningful to be revealed. Moving to the vibrant wall with "R+D" emblazoned, surrounded by displays and books, I sense curiosity igniting. There is a tension here—between collective expectation and personal reflection—inviting me to question and explore, to connect deeper with knowledge and those around me.
